fusions.name: Plummet
fusions.desc: Lifts you to an enemy up to 7 tiles away and drops you on it, which deals 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Clutch of Four
fusions.desc: Throws an egg from your clutch that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Updraft
fusions.desc: Lifts you 4 tiles from where you stood. For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you; transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Long Migration
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
